资料来源ICN，由种花小医杂家赵收集整理翻译，转载请注明泛景主题站及译者。卡罗拉在自然界也存在类似七福神的光谱现象，各个分布地的种群存在渐变差异，从分类学角度上将两种极端的形态赋予变型地位。
两个变型即：
圆叶的卡罗拉（即林赛）Echeveria colorata f. colorata 泛景站内地址：http://funjing.com/forum.php?mod ... ;highlight=colorata
尖叶的勃兰特 Echeveria colorata f. brandtiii 泛景站内地址：http://funjing.com/forum.php?mod ... ;highlight=colorata其中卡罗拉（林赛）作为亲本在园艺种培育中大放异彩，本文介绍几种常见的卡罗拉杂交后代。

elegans 'Albicans' x colorata 'Lindsayana'
未正式定名，亲本为：厚叶月影*卡罗拉
E. albicans x lindsayana - the original name of this hybrid - has been created by Bob Grim, California.
As the hybrid is known world-wide it seems likely that other breeders have made the same crossing. The hybrid resembles much more E. elegans than E. colorata.
亲本组合即它的原始名字，由加州的Bob Grim育成。这个杂交种世界知名，似乎其他的育种者也尝试了与之相同的杂交组合。这个杂交种更加像它的亲本厚叶月影多一些。

Parentage : Echeveria chihuahuaensis 吉娃娃x E. colorata 'Lindsayana' 卡罗拉培育人不详.
In Korea this hybrid is called "Chihuahualindsa" - according to the Code not a valid name.
在韩国这个杂交种被叫做 "Chihuahualindsa" ，不符合命名原则。In Europe this hybrid is distributed with the wrong name 'Tippy', but it can easily be told apart from the correct 'Tippy'- the rosette of the latter is much paler, the leaf shape is different and the flowers are by far not the same.
在欧洲这个品种被误标为蒂比，其实很容易分辨出真正的蒂比，蒂比的植株显得更加苍白一些。叶形和花也有很大差别。Without flowers this hybrid is indistinguishable from E. chihuahuaensis and also the flowers are only little different from those of the species. It should better not have been created - it is only confusing.
除了花以外，这个杂交种和吉娃娃几乎难以区分，且花也仅与吉娃娃有微小不同。这个品种只给人带来困惑，也许根本不该培育出来。
